sources.title: How do I build a simple text link to a specific item on Amazon?
quotes: ASIN: ASIN is the 10-digit code that Amazon uses to denote specific products. It is short for “Amazon.com Standard Item Number.” Every item in our catalog has a unique ASIN.
This link format qualifies for the direct link bonus.
YOURASSOCIATEID: YOURASSOCIATEID is the unique ID that is used to identify your Associates account, automatically generated when you apply for the Associates Programme.
used_for: the checkable ASIN identifier the product-intent record is built on (10-digit/10-character rule)
the tagged link format an official Amazon page publishes
the tag= parameter every Special Link must carry
